title: Zero-Copy Bridge
content:
Photon's most significant optimization is the Zero-Copy Bridge. In traditional frameworks, incoming requests are parsed and cloned into multiple objects before reaching your business logic. This consumes CPU cycles and increases memory pressure.

How it works

Photon communicates directly with the Bun runtime's internal buffers. When a request arrives, we map the memory address directly to the FastContext. No intermediate string cloning occurs unless your logic explicitly requests it.

In baseline testing, Zero-Copy transfer reduces request dispatch latency by up to 18.4%.
